name: issuebadge
description: Issue verifiable certificates and badges from your IssueBadge templates.

interface.longDescription: Issue verifiable certificates and digital badges to anyone without leaving ChatGPT. Pick one of your IssueBadge templates, name the recipient, and IssueBadge emails the certificate and returns a public verification link. Useful for course completions, event attendance, employee recognition and training records. IssueBadge only accesses the templates and credentials of your connected account.
defaultPrompt: Which certificate templates do I have?
Issue the Certificate of Completion to Jane Doe, jane.doe@example.com

positive.prompt: Which certificate templates do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the badge templates of the connected IssueBadge account with their names and ids.

positive.prompt: Issue the Certificate of Completion to Jane Doe, jane.doe@example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the matching template, issues the certificate and shows the certificate card with recipient, certificate id and a Verify link; IssueBadge emails the recipient.

positive.description: Issue and show the verification link
positive.prompt: Issue the same certificate to Sam Lee, sam.lee@example.com, and show me the verification link
positive.expected_behavior: Issues the certificate and repeats the public verification URL, which opens a valid certificate page.
Reports that the connected IssueBadge account is valid.

positive.description: Ask before issuing to several people
positive.prompt: Send the Certificate of Completion to Ana Silva, ana.silva@example.com and Lee Park, lee.park@example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the template, then issues one certificate per recipient with a separate idempotency key and lists both verification links.

negative.description: Unknown template: The tool returns an IssueBadge error for the invalid template and no certificate is issued.
negative.prompt: Issue the certificate with id DOESNOTEXIST to Jane Doe, jane@example.com

negative.description: Invalid email: Input validation rejects the email before any API call; nothing is issued.
negative.prompt: Issue the Certificate of Completion to Jane Doe with the email not-an-email

negative.description: Out of scope action: No tool deletes or revokes credentials; the assistant explains this is not available in ChatGPT and points to the IssueBadge dashboard.
negative.prompt: Delete all certificates I have ever issued

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list certificate templates and issue verifiable certificates through your connected IssueBadge account.
